triage.kind_span: 262,669,923 Rights for 26,266,993 Shares of Common Stock

subject_names.span: The Gabelli Equity Trust Inc. (the “Fund”, “we”, “us” or “our”) is issuing subscription rights (the “Rights”) to our common stockholders

subject_tickers.span: The Common Shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE”) under the symbol “GAB.”

security_class.span: Subscription Rights to Acquire Shares of Common Stock

rights_per_share.span: One Right will be issued in respect of each Common Share of the Fund outstanding as of the close of business on the Record Date.

rights_per_new_share.span: Ten Rights will be required to purchase one Common Share.

price_reference.span: Ten Rights may be exercised at a price of $5.50 per Common Share (the “Subscription Price”).

record_date.span: Rights will be issued to holders of record of the Fund’s Common Shares as of the close of business on June 2, 2021 (the “Record Date”).

expiration_date.span: which will be 5:00 PM Eastern Time on July 14, 2021 (the “Expiration Date”), unless otherwise extended.

transferable.span: The Rights are transferable and will be admitted for trading on the NYSE under the symbol “GAB RT”.

over_subscription.span: An over-subscription privilege will be offered, subject to the right of the Board of Directors of the Fund (the “Board”) to eliminate the over-subscription privilege.

max_new_shares.span: 26,266,993 Common Shares of the Fund will be issued if all Rights are exercised.

notes: Fixed subscription price of $5.50 per Common Share (no percent of NAV or market, so price_pct and price_floor_pct_nav are null). Prospectus supplement dated June 2, 2021 to the N-2ASR prospectus dated December 23, 2020. NAV per share on May 28, 2021 is stated as $6.87 and last sale price $7.54 (context only). max_new_shares is the stated primary issuance if all Rights are exercised (262,669,923 shares outstanding as of May 28, 2021); the filing also states that, if NAV exceeds the subscription price, over-subscription shares will not take the offering ratio beyond one new share for each three Rights, and that the Board may eliminate the over-subscription privilege. Only the common shares are acted on; the Fund's preferred series (GAB PrG/PrH/PrJ/PrK) are mentioned for context. New shares are not entitled to the quarterly distribution paid June 23, 2021. Expiration date stated once (unless otherwise extended).
